_about: What Word 16.106 drew for tools/make_numbering_probe.py: every text object (as render-observations.json records them), each case's lines as Word drew them (page and baseline from the case's label, left edge, glyphs: the list labels among them), the renderer's scores against them -- cases per family, lines within half a pixel, the glyph row -- and every face number the renderer asked for. Measurements only; regenerate with tools/read_numbering_probe.py --record.
